feeds.title: Horror Cult Films
feeds.description: Horror Cult Films reviews the latest movies from big budget to B-movie cinema. With book reviews & video game reviews, we're your one-stop horror hub.

feeds.title: SCREAM - The World's Number One Horror Magazine
feeds.description: The world's scariest publication, SCREAM - Blood, guts, gore & more! We cover films, celebrity interviews, DVDs/Blu-rays, festivals, books, games, comics, graphic novels, fiction/non-Fiction, photography, clothing/fashion, news, reviews, previews, competitions, on-location film reports & much, much more!

feeds.title: This Is Horror
feeds.description: This Is Horror specialises in horror fiction and the craft of writing. Stick around on This Is Horror and you can enjoy a podcast dedicated to readers, writers and creator, books written by some of the best minds in dark fiction today, Book reviews of the latest horror and genre releases, Thought-provoking features, Up-to-date news and much more

feeds.title: MOVIES and MANIA
feeds.description: MOVIES and MANIA is the handy online way of exploring the world of cult cinema with a focus on horror, thrillers, sci-fi, and fantasy. No other website covers as many new releases as well as so many classic and obscure films. We are passionate, relentless, and aim to be as methodical as we can be.

feeds.title: Horrorscreams Videovault
feeds.description: Supporting Independent Horror Movie News, Reviews, Interviews, Trailers, Articles and more.

feeds.title: British Horror Revival
feeds.description: British Horror Revival blog provides news and updates on new, recent and forthcoming British horror films, and updates on my book Urban Terrors: New British Horror Cinema 1997-2008.

feeds.title: The London Horror Society
feeds.description: We're an incredibly fast growing community for all UK horror fans and professionals to come together and share the love of our favourite genre. We're also here to support the creation of low budget, independent film making and everyone involved in doing so.

feeds.title: Dark Universe: Horror Database
feeds.description: Horror Database is your reliable entertainment source for the latest horror news and reviews, along with videos, trailers, and music.

feeds.title: Dead Northern
feeds.description: Dead Northern - Northern England's Horror Experience Film Festival and Popup Cinema. Putting the Festival in the Horror Film Festival.
